result.reason: The added clause includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for Licensee data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It leaves the unrelated representation-by-counsel provision unchanged. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after the term exceeds the playbook and is broader than necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. The language is otherwise professionally drafted.
